name: next-steps-plus
description: After each turn, suggests up to three next prompts above the input, informed by the repo's git state, its pull request and checks, and your own notes. Hover or focus a suggestion to see its full prompt; 1, 2 or 3 puts it in the prompt box as an editable draft, 0 dismisses.

minAnswerChars.title: Shortest answer to suggest after
minAnswerChars.description: Skip suggestions after answers shorter than this many characters.

suggestSkills.title: Suggest skills and slash commands
suggestSkills.description: Tell the suggester which skills and slash commands this session has, so a suggestion can be one of them.

gitContext.title: Read the git state
gitContext.description: Branch, ahead/behind, changed files and recent commits of the working directory's repo (local git only).

prContext.title: Read the branch's pull request
prContext.description: The branch's PR, review and check status via the gh CLI (read-only, a network call at most every two minutes per branch).

notesFiles.title: Notes files to read
notesFiles.description: Comma-separated paths whose opening part is shown to the suggester, e.g. a per-branch notes file. Placeholders: {repo}, {branch}, {branch_dashed} (slashes as dashes), {home}; a leading ~ is your home. Missing files are skipped.

notesIndexDirs.title: Notes folders to index
notesIndexDirs.description: Comma-separated folders whose Markdown files are listed by title (not content), e.g. a per-repo handbook, so a suggestion can point at the entry that applies. Same placeholders.
